semantic_expectations.subject: Settings projections
semantic_expectations.excluded_for_these_outputs: Other getSettings members, including clientEmail/privateKey, do not affect these selected outputs; getSettings still eagerly reads them in actual forward facts.

semantic_expectations.subject: Settings validation versus authentication
semantic_expectations.required: validateSettings.valid/errors depend on truthiness of propertyId,clientEmail,privateKey, not their full string content. SDK credential constructors consume clientEmail/privateKey values.
semantic_expectations.excluded_for_these_outputs: siteUrl,resultsDir,defaultDateRange are not validation inputs. No source proof that the private key is sent in plaintext in any of the 13 explicit request objects.

semantic_expectations.subject: saveResult output-specific dependencies
semantic_expectations.required: On the successful-write path, the returned filepath text is constructed from resultsDir/category/operation, truthiness and value of extraInfo when used, and filename clock components. Preserving the write action additionally needs data, propertyId and savedAt clock; content serialization/write failure can prevent return.
semantic_expectations.excluded_for_these_outputs: data and propertyId are absent from the filepath construction. This is not independence from write success or permission to delete the data needed by the save action. Credentials/defaultDateRange/siteUrl are absent from the saved wrapper. Every enumerated caller ignores filepath; preserving the write does not require a synthetic public return.

semantic_expectations.subject: Metadata projections
semantic_expectations.required: getAvailableDimensions selects response.dimensions or []; getAvailableMetrics selects response.metrics or []. Preserve their fallback conditions and entire selected member values.
semantic_expectations.excluded_for_these_outputs: The other top-level metadata branch and response.name do not determine the selected result. Do not assume SDK member objects contain only three declared TypeScript fields.

semantic_expectations.subject: Inspection projections and wrapper use
semantic_expectations.required: inspectUrl constructs selected fields with truthy/optional fallbacks; checkIndexStatus(save:false) requires only returned indexStatus, with verdict additionally determining indexed.
semantic_expectations.excluded_for_these_outputs: inspectionResultLink,mobileUsability,richResults are not used by checkIndexStatus; other raw inspectionResult siblings are not copied by inspectUrl.

semantic_expectations.subject: Unused documented report options
semantic_expectations.required: References advertise filters/orderBy, and ReportOptions declares them; runReport destructures both without using them.
semantic_expectations.excluded_for_these_outputs: Neither field influences the implemented request/response/save. A task using documented filtering/sorting needs a missing-functionality finding; discarding those fields alone does not fulfill that declared task.

semantic_expectations.subject: Optional presence, truthiness and defaults
semantic_expectations.required: runReport.limit is emitted only when truthy; optional extraInfo is used only when truthy. Destructured defaults for save/dimensions/rowLimit/startRow apply when undefined. date parsing falls back for any falsy range.
semantic_expectations.excluded_for_these_outputs: Do not conflate known absence with false/0/empty-string values or mark every optional option as always mandatory. if_present on an actual request field is not a substitute for its source construction guard.

semantic_expectations.subject: Closed aggregate output parts
semantic_expectations.required: Each aggregate object in index.ts has the explicit component keys enumerated in S15-S23. A complete aggregate demand can preserve these parts and structural obligations.
semantic_expectations.excluded_for_these_outputs: Explicit wrapper keys do not prove exhaustive field coverage of nested opaque SDK responses. Type assertions are not transformations.

semantic_expectations.subject: Loop occurrence and exception pairing
semantic_expectations.required: requestIndexingBatch, reindexUrls and checkIndexStatus each loop over supplied URLs. Preserve each URL/result or URL/error relationship, including duplicate occurrences; child saves are disabled.
semantic_expectations.excluded_for_these_outputs: Do not deduplicate URLs, pair one member URL with another response, infer unbounded actual calls from one static site, or fabricate full generic exception semantics.

semantic_expectations.subject: Source purposes and automatic saving
semantic_expectations.required: SKILL declares analysis, timestamped auto-save and subsequent markdown summarization. Wrapper exports expose alternative capabilities; the caller selects among them.
semantic_expectations.excluded_for_these_outputs: No fixed external user task is imported. One aggregate and its default child saves are actual separate sites; their redundancy is not proof of unnecessary behavior under the declared all-results auto-save wording.
